app.name: PantryPilot
app.startupErrorHint: The local database could not be opened. Error:
app.devPreview: Browser preview: data is stored only in this browser

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: What is in your kitchen right now
dashboard.nutritionBody: Combine foods and weights for a meal and see the nutrient totals.
dashboard.emptyBody: Start by adding something you bought, like a steak or a bag of komatsuna.
dashboard.cookableSubtitle: Uses up food that expires soon
dashboard.cookableEmpty: Nothing can be cooked right away. Check the recipes page to see what is missing.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Every package you actually own
inventory.searchPlaceholder: Search by name (中文 / English / 日本語)
inventory.emptyAllBody: Click “Add food” to record what you bought.
inventory.confirmDeleteBody: “{{name}}” and its history will be permanently deleted. If you simply ate it, use “Consume” instead.
inventory.confirmDiscardBody: What is left of “{{name}}” will be recorded as discarded.

errors.exceeds_remaining: That is more than what is left
errors.weight_not_tracked: This item has no recorded weight
errors.count_not_tracked: This item has no recorded count

addFood.description: Only the food and quantity are required. Everything else can be filled in later.
addFood.searchPlaceholder: Search: beef, ミスジ, salmon, komatsuna…
addFood.noResults: Nothing found. You can create a custom ingredient in “Ingredients”.
addFood.cutFallbackHint: No dedicated nutrition data for this cut yet; nutrition will use “{{name}}”.
addFood.noEstimate: No weight estimate for this unit; nutrition cannot be calculated.
addFood.labelTextPlaceholder: e.g. 牛ミスジステーキ用
addFood.parsedLabel: Cut and form filled in from the label
addFood.parseFailed: No cut or form recognised in the label

validation.nonNegativeNumber: Enter a number of 0 or more
validation.nutritionIncomplete: When entering nutrition, energy, protein, fat and carbohydrate are all required
validation.positiveInteger: Enter a whole number greater than 0
validation.requiredIngredient: Add at least one non-optional ingredient

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.subtitle: Combine foods and weights to see nutrient totals. This page checks the data; it is not dietary advice.
nutrition.itemsEmpty: Add foods on the left, e.g. rice 180 g, salmon 140 g, komatsuna 100 g.
nutrition.itemNoData: No nutrition data; excluded from totals
nutrition.partialHint: * Incomplete: only {{known}} of {{total}} foods report this value, so the total is a lower bound
nutrition.partialLegend: * Some foods lack this value, so the total is only a lower bound. Hover a value for details.
nutrition.disclaimer: This tool only adds up numbers. It gives no medical or dietary advice and sets no calorie targets. Built-in nutrition values are approximate demo data.

scores.title: Heuristic scores (experimental)
scores.subtitle: Rough indicators, not health advice. Never stored.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.subtitle: Ingredient definitions describe nutritional identity: different cuts of the same meat are different definitions.
ingredients.demoWarning: Demo data: approximate values, not verified against an authoritative source. Do not use for dietary or medical decisions.
ingredients.deleteInUse: Used by {{count}} inventory item(s); cannot delete
ingredients.formNutritionHint: Leave blank if unsure. Blank means “unknown”, never zero.
ingredients.deleteInRecipes: {{count}} custom recipe(s) use this ingredient. Edit or delete them first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.regionHint: Will be used to choose default nutrition datasets and supermarket vocabulary.
settings.exportHint: JSON file with inventory, history, custom ingredients and settings.
settings.importHint: Importing replaces all current inventory and custom ingredients.
settings.importConfirmTitle: Replace current data with this backup?
settings.importConfirmBody: Backup from {{date}} with {{lots}} inventory items, {{ingredients}} custom ingredients and {{transactions}} history entries. Current data will be replaced and this cannot be undone — consider exporting first.

importErrors.invalid_json: The file is not valid JSON
importErrors.not_a_backup: This is not a PantryPilot backup
importErrors.unsupported_version: Unsupported backup format version {{version}}. Please update the app.

settings.privacyStatement: PantryPilot V0.1 stores user data locally and does not send inventory or nutrition data to external servers.
settings.demoNotice: Built-in nutrition values are approximate demo data for development and testing. Importing official datasets is planned.
settings.licenseNotice: An open-source license has not been selected yet.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.subtitle: See what you can cook with what you have
recipes.searchPlaceholder: Search recipes or ingredients (中文 / English / 日本語)
recipes.demoNotice: Built-in recipes are examples with typical home-cooking amounts, not tested cookbook recipes. Seasonings are not matched against inventory.
recipes.stockUnknown: In stock, but the amount is not recorded. Please check it is enough
recipes.nutritionNote: Estimated from the main ingredients, excluding seasonings. Built-in nutrition values are demo data. * means some ingredients lack this value.
recipes.confirmDeleteBody: “{{name}}” will be deleted. Recorded inventory history is kept.
recipes.toastDuplicated: Copied as “{{name}}” — edit it as you like
recipes.cookDescription: For {{count}} serving(s). Confirm which lots to deduct and how much. The earliest-expiring lots are used first; enter 0 to skip a lot.
recipes.cookNoStock: Not in stock — will be skipped

cookErrors.weight_not_tracked: This lot has no weight recorded: {{name}}
cookErrors.count_not_tracked: This lot has no count recorded: {{name}}
cookErrors.stale: Inventory changed just now, so nothing was deducted. Close and reopen to try again.
cookErrors.operation_conflict: This cooking was already saved with different amounts. Nothing was deducted again; close the dialog and check your inventory.

recipes.formIngredientsHint: Enter edible grams for the servings above. List soy sauce, salt and other seasonings below; they are not matched against inventory.
recipes.stockNearly: Uses {{used}}, {{gap}} less than the recipe, close enough
recipes.stockShared: Only {{used}} available, {{gap}} short (the rest goes to other ingredients of this recipe)
recipes.stockSharedNone: All matching stock goes to other ingredients of this recipe
recipes.stockUnknownPartial: {{used}} known, plus stock with no recorded amount. Please check it is enough
recipes.stockUncertain: Shares stock with other ingredients; could not tell automatically whether it is enough. Please check
recipes.noteEdibleRatio: {{name}} is bone-in or whole; {{percent}} counted as edible
recipes.noteEdibleUnknown: {{name}} is bone-in with no known edible share; the full weight is used as an estimate
recipes.noteFormDiffers: {{name}}: the recipe suggests {{form}}; you may need to cut it
recipes.excludedForm: {{names}}: form does not suit this dish, not counted
recipes.excludedPrepared: {{names}}: already cooked, not counted as a raw cut
recipes.cookChoiceUnknown: Some amounts cannot be converted to grams; the entered amounts are deducted
